Potatopedia profile marks

Six options for the YouTube channel and the LinkedIn page, each shown the way the platforms show it: a circle at channel size, page size and comment size, plus the square file. All are 800×800 PNG, Potatopedia red, cream, dark and tan, Poppins, one real Adobe Stock potato.

Today
Red square with the potato photo, on LinkedIn and YouTube now
Option A

Red field, real potato

The current idea, refined: a real potato on a deeper red with soft light and shadow. Reads at every size and stays closest to the site.

docs/brand/profile-options/option-A-800.png
Option B

Cream, red ring

Quiet and premium. The thin ring frames the circle crop on YouTube and LinkedIn; the potato stays large.

docs/brand/profile-options/option-B-800.png
Option C

Dark, tan ring, wordmark

Matches the dark data scenes in the videos and the tan P app icon. The wordmark shows at 800 px and fades out gracefully at 48 px.

docs/brand/profile-options/option-C-800.png
Option D

Monogram P with potato

A bold Poppins P on a red disc with a small real potato tucked in. Strongest at tiny sizes such as comments and replies.

docs/brand/profile-options/option-D-800.png
Option E

Data mark

A red potato silhouette carrying three rising bars: the knowledge base in one shape. Unique to Potatopedia and needs no photo.

docs/brand/profile-options/option-E-800.png
Option F

Split wordmark

Name only, two lines, tan rule between. Clear on the channel page; the words blur at 48 px, so it suits YouTube more than LinkedIn.

docs/brand/profile-options/option-F-800.png
Suggested pair: Option A for both YouTube and LinkedIn (same mark everywhere, closest to the site, clearest at 40 px). If you want the channel to feel more like the videos, use C on YouTube and A on LinkedIn. Reply with a letter and I will upload it to both.
